Results.ReviewText:
I didn’t believe the hype about a real name brand grill until I purchased a Weber.
Think of a Weber as a fast pass at your local amusement park, once you have one there’s no way going back to normal.
I was torn between this grill and the spirit with enclosed propane storage but the wheels sold me. 
The spirit E-310 delivers a clean and flavorful experience and I’m constantly looking for more things to grill. The 3 burner size is perfect for a family of 4 and I don’t feel like I need more space.
Results.Title: Best bang for your buck.

Results.ReviewText: I eyed the grill with suspicion. My husband has always been the grill guy in our home, and I happily let him delight me with his recipes. However, a stroke left him unable to be trusted when lighting the grill and keeping track of time. However, he still wanted grilled foods, so I decided I needed to expand my cooking skills. Our old Weber grill needed replacing, and I didn't want something huge. A little research brought me to the Spirit II as a nice compromise. My daughter and I bought the grill as a Father's Day gift for my husband, and he was thrilled to "teach" me a few things about outdoor cooking. Thank you for making a grill that a novice like me can handle, and that my husband appreciates for its quality.
Results.Title: Passing the grill torch, so to speak

45010001.Description:
Get ready to step up your grilling experience. As the family sits down for dinner, or a couple of friends come over for a bite – this three burner grill will do its magic. With the spacious cooking area you can sear steaks on one side while grilling an appetizer on the other, and the convenient open-cart allows you to keep your tools and equipment within reach. Armed with the strong GS4 grilling system, this gas grill is sure to take you and your meals to the next level.
